home.title: Make critical infrastructure sourcing precise and dependable
home.description: RICEWIND supports communications and energy integrators and procurement teams with product selection, structured technical data, and project coordination.
home.aboutTitle: Clear, consistent information from specification to delivery
home.aboutBody: We organize structured product data for telecom power, facility distribution, and supporting energy equipment, helping buyers confirm models, verified parameters, and applications.
home.productBody: Cooling, power, and infrastructure-management products for telecom rooms, data centers, and critical power environments.

cabinetAir.title: Cabinet Air Conditioners
cabinetAir.description: Close-coupled cooling equipment for high-density cabinets, organized around rack space and heat-load requirements.

precisionAir.title: Precision Air Conditioners
precisionAir.description: Environmental control for data rooms and telecom facilities, selected according to site and operating conditions.

dcPower.title: DC Power Systems
dcPower.description: Rectification, distribution, and monitoring equipment for DC supply chains in telecom sites and equipment rooms.

upsPower.title: UPS Power Systems
upsPower.description: Uninterruptible power for critical AC loads, configured by capacity, backup time, and deployment method.

indoorPower.title: Indoor Power Systems
indoorPower.description: Integrated rectification, distribution, monitoring, and backup units for indoor telecom and equipment applications.

kvm.title: KVM Systems
kvm.description: Centralized local control for rack equipment while reducing the space used by duplicate displays and input devices.

siteEnergy.title: Site Energy Systems
siteEnergy.description: Integrated intelligent power and hybrid energy storage systems for telecom base stations and outdoor sites.

home.solutionBody: We align equipment with site conditions across power continuity, thermal management, and communications operations, with clear selection priorities and delivery boundaries.
